title: The dispute in one minute
status: At the capture cutoffs: all three GitHub threads are closed, and translation PR #98 is unmerged.

items.label: The request
items.text: On October 23, Will (doggy8088) proposed a Traditional Chinese locale and submitted translations plus shared-interface changes. He later disclosed AI assistance and said he had reviewed the work.

items.label: The escalation
items.text: arp242 first objected to agent-mediated submissions and closed the original issue and PR. The new issue #99 on October 25 was closed and locked after the maintainer linked the Facebook post and confronted the contributor.

items.label: The disagreement
items.text: The contributor wants the result judged on quality; the maintainer expects carefully vetted human translations for the official site. Review evidence, maintenance costs, tone and wording extending suspicion to future zh-TW translations are also disputed.

items.label: The responses
items.text: Facebook contains support as well as criticism about integrity, public shaming and maintenance costs. In one reply, Will explicitly accepts criticism and acknowledges insufficient consideration; elsewhere he continues to prioritize result quality.

limit: Public statements and recorded actions can be checked. This chronicle has not comprehensively reviewed the translations or resolved every allegation of deception, mobilization or discrimination.
